zh: 每日 Picks 支持本地通知提醒，Picks 页新增 Newsletter 订阅入口
聊天支持发送图片（拍照/相册），新增一键详细解读，回复全程流式展示
首页支持设置默认打开的标签页
AI 摘要语言支持独立设置，不再跟随应用语言
应用内更新提示现在会展示新版本的更新内容
设置页改版更清爽，并修复了上个版本启动崩溃的问题
en: Daily Picks now supports local notification reminders, with a Newsletter subscription entry added to the Picks tab
Chat now supports sending images (camera/gallery), with one-tap deep dive and fully streamed responses
Set which tab the home screen opens by default
Summary language can now be set independently from the app language
In-app update prompts now show what's new in the release
Redesigned Settings page with a cleaner layout, and fixed a startup crash in the previous release
